task: Welcome to TextWorld! Here is how to play! First of all, you could, like, look and see that the hatch is open. And then, make an attempt to venture west. That done, go to the west. Then, try to travel north. And then, make an attempt to go north. And then, take a trip east. Then, try to travel south. Then, lift the passkey from the floor of the office. After that, make an effort to move south. And then, go east. And then, insert the passkey into the portal inside the sauna's lock to unlock it. After that, ensure that the portal within the sauna is open. After that, go to the east. Next, retrieve the paper towel from the cabinet. That's it!
